user.title: Medication Tracker
user.description: Create a Medication Tracker entry and manage medications through integration options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Medication Tracker entry is supported.

init.title: Medication Tracker
init.description: Add and manage medications, people or pets, reminders, and refill settings.

add_medication_pick_database.title: Medication Catalog
add_medication_pick_database.description: Choose a bundled medication template to pre-fill common details, or choose a custom medication if it is not listed.

add_medication_pick_profile.title: Who Is This For?
add_medication_pick_profile.description: Select an existing person or pet, or create a new profile first.

add_medication_profile_new.title: Create Profile
add_medication_profile_new.description: Enter the name of the person or pet. Medication Tracker will create the technical ID for you automatically.

data_description.profile_name: Examples: Mike, Mum, Bella the dog. This is the friendly name shown in Home Assistant.

add_medication_basic.title: Basic Details
add_medication_basic.description: Start with the medication name, dose, and any notes you want to keep with it.

data_description.medication_name: The name you want to see on buttons, sensors, and notifications.
data_description.notes: Optional notes such as take with food or morning only.

add_medication_schedule_count.title: How Often?
add_medication_schedule_count.description: Choose how many times per day this medication should be scheduled.

add_medication_schedule.title: Schedule Times
add_medication_schedule.description: Pick up to six times for this medication. Only the first time is required.

data_description.time_slot_1: Required. The first scheduled time for this medication.

add_medication_advanced.title: Advanced Settings
add_medication_advanced.description: Optional settings for stock tracking, reminders, caregiver workflows, richer medication notes, NFC logging, and refill warnings.

data_description.quantity: Optional. How many doses or units you currently have left.
data_description.refill_at: Optional. Trigger refill warnings when quantity drops to this number or below.
data_description.nfc_tag_id: Optional. Scan this NFC tag to log the medication as taken.
data_description.notify_service: Optional. Choose a notify service to send actionable reminders to a phone.
data_description.caregiver_name: Optional. The person responsible for checking or supervising this medication routine.
data_description.caregiver_notify_service: Optional. A separate notify service for the caregiver if reminders or confirmations should go to them.
data_description.confirmation_required: Turn this on if a caregiver should review or confirm logged doses.
data_description.purpose: Optional. What this medication is for, such as acid reflux or blood pressure support.
data_description.form: Optional. Examples: tablet, capsule, inhaler, injection.
data_description.instructions: Optional. Food timing, handling guidance, or routine notes.
data_description.notification_enabled: Turn scheduled reminders and missed-dose alerts on or off for this medication.
data_description.reminder_minutes: How long after the scheduled time the medication should count as due.
data_description.missed_after_minutes: How long after the scheduled time to treat the dose as missed.
data_description.duplicate_guard_minutes: Block accidental repeat logs for this many minutes after the last dose. Set to 0 to disable.

edit_medication_basic.title: Basic Details
edit_medication_basic.description: Update the name, dose, and notes for this medication.

data_description.profile_name: The friendly name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.medication_name: The name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.notes: Optional notes such as take with food or morning only.

edit_medication_schedule_count.title: How Often?
edit_medication_schedule_count.description: Choose how many schedule times you want to edit.

edit_medication_schedule.title: Schedule Times
edit_medication_schedule.description: Update the times for this medication. Only the first time is required.
